title: Baked Mackerel Tamales
description: A unique fusion of Mexican and seafood flavors, perfect for a dinner night.
instructions: Soak corn husks in water for at least 30 minutes.
In a bowl, mix together Mexican spice mix, lime juice, cilantro, butter, salt, and black pepper.
Place a mackerel fillet in the center of a corn husk, leaving a 1-inch border around the fish.
Brush the spice mix mixture on the mackerel fillet, then fold the corn husk to enclose the fish.
Place the tamales in a steamer basket, steam for 12-15 minutes, or until the corn husks are tender.
Transfer the tamales to a baking dish, bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
